label: Discovery & lead optimisation
scope: Sequence/chemistry selection, in vitro screening, candidate nomination.
oligo_note: Hybridisation-based target ID; chemistry (PS, 2'-MOE, cEt, GalNAc) set here.

label: IND/CTA-enabling nonclinical package
scope: Pivotal tox, safety pharmacology, genotox, TK before first-in-human.

label: CTA / IND submission
scope: Authorisation to begin human trials.

label: First-in-human / Phase 1
scope: Safety, tolerability, PK in humans.

label: Phase 2
scope: Dose-finding, proof of concept.

label: End-of-Phase-2 interaction
scope: Pivotal-design alignment; paediatric plan triggers cluster here.

label: Phase 3 / pivotal
scope: Confirmatory efficacy & safety.

label: MAA / NDA / BLA submission
scope: Marketing application dossier (CTD).

label: Marketing authorisation
scope: Approval decision.

label: Post-approval / pharmacovigilance
scope: Variations, PSUR/PBRER, paediatric & RMP commitments.

label: ICH M3(R2) — Nonclinical safety for clinical trials
scope: Timing/extent of nonclinical studies relative to clinical phases.
oligo_note: Default backbone; oligos not biotech products, so M3 (not S6) frames timing.

label: ICH S1A/S1B(R1)/S1C(R2) — Carcinogenicity
scope: Need for and design of carcinogenicity studies.

label: ICH S2(R1) — Genotoxicity
scope: Standard genotoxicity battery.
oligo_note: Standard battery often of limited value; hybridisation-based genotox is sequence-specific.

label: ICH S3A — Toxicokinetics
scope: Systemic exposure in toxicity studies.

label: ICH S5(R3) — Reproductive & developmental toxicity
scope: DART study design.

label: ICH S6(R1) — Preclinical safety of biotech products
scope: Applies to the antibody/protein component of conjugates, not the oligo itself.
oligo_note: Relevant only for antibody-oligonucleotide conjugates (AOC) / protein carriers.

label: ICH S7A — Safety pharmacology
scope: Core battery (CV, CNS, respiratory).

label: ICH S7B — Delayed ventricular repolarisation (QT)
scope: In vitro IKr and in vivo QT assessment.

label: ICH S9 — Nonclinical evaluation for anticancer pharmaceuticals
scope: Reduced nonclinical package for advanced-cancer indications.
oligo_note: Directly relevant for paediatric-oncology oligonucleotides.

label: ICH S11 — Nonclinical safety for paediatric development
scope: When/what juvenile animal studies are needed.
oligo_note: Central for paediatric oligonucleotide programmes.

label: ICH Q2(R2) — Analytical procedure validation
scope: Validation of analytical methods.

label: ICH Q3A(R2) — Impurities in new drug substances
scope: Reporting/identification/qualification thresholds for impurities.
oligo_note: Thresholds designed for small molecules; oligo process impurities (n±1, shortmers) need tailored justification.

label: ICH Q3D(R2) — Elemental impurities
scope: Elemental impurity limits.

label: ICH Q6A — Specifications
scope: Setting specifications for new drug substances/products.

label: ICH Q11 — Development & manufacture of drug substances
scope: CMC development incl. starting-material justification.
oligo_note: Starting-material concept contentious for synthetic oligos (amidites).

label: ICH M7(R2) — Mutagenic impurities
scope: Assessment/control of DNA-reactive impurities.

label: ICH E6(R3) — Good Clinical Practice
status_note: in force; Principles+Annex 1 Step 4 2025-01-06 (EU effective 2025-07-23); Annex 2 Step 4 2026-06-03, consolidated Step 4 2026-06-16 (EU effective 2027-01-15)
scope: GCP for trial conduct.

label: ICH E8(R1) — General considerations for clinical studies
scope: Quality-by-design of clinical programmes.

label: ICH E11(R1) — Paediatric clinical investigation
scope: Conduct of paediatric clinical trials.

label: ICH E11A — Paediatric extrapolation
scope: Framework for extrapolating adult data to children.
oligo_note: Key lever to shrink paediatric oligo programmes.

label: ICH E17 — Multi-regional clinical trials
scope: Design of MRCTs.

label: ICH M4 — Common Technical Document (CTD)
scope: Dossier structure for marketing applications.

label: FDA — Clinical pharmacology considerations for oligonucleotide therapeutics
status_note: final (June 2024; FR notice 2024-06-17, FR Doc. 2024-13271; supersedes draft of 2022-06-27, 87 FR 38161)
scope: QT, immunogenicity, hepatic/renal impairment, DDI for oligos.
oligo_note: The single most oligo-specific clin-pharm reference.

label: FDA — IND submissions for individualised ASO products (clinical, draft)
scope: Clinical/IND expectations for n-of-1 ASOs.
oligo_note: Pathway for bespoke ASOs (Milasen-type).

label: FDA — Nonclinical testing of individualised ASO products (draft)
scope: Minimal nonclinical package for n-of-1 ASOs (SDLT diseases).
oligo_note: Risk-based, abbreviated tox for individualised ASOs.

label: FDA — Plausible Mechanism framework for individualised therapies
status_note: draft (Feb 2026; 60-day comment period expected to end ~2026-04-27)
scope: Evidence framework for individualised genome-editing and RNA therapies (explicitly ASOs): single externally controlled investigation with natural-history control, platform protocols, traditional or accelerated approval.
oligo_note: The 2026 FDA pathway for bespoke oligonucleotides; builds on the three 2021 individualised-ASO drafts. Docket number not stated in the PDF.

label: EMA — Guideline on development and manufacture of oligonucleotides (draft)
status_note: draft (consultation 2024-07-22 to 2025-01-31; adoption not stated on EMA page as of 2026-10-28)
scope: First EU quality guideline specific to synthetic oligonucleotides: starting materials, impurities, specifications, manufacturing process.
oligo_note: Consultation closed Jan 2025; adoption not yet announced. Preceded by concept paper EMA/CHMP/QWP/735423/2022.

label: Ph. Eur. — texts applicable to synthetic oligonucleotides
status_note: negative result re-confirmed 2026-10-28: no oligonucleotide item in EDQM Ph. Eur. newsroom (latest item 2025-04-14) or Pharmeuropa 38.2 (2026-04-02); general monograph 2034 applies
scope: No dedicated oligonucleotide chapter found; general monograph 2034 'Substances for pharmaceutical use' and general methods apply.
oligo_note: No oligo-specific purity limits in Ph. Eur.; rely on the EMA draft guideline. Check Pharmeuropa before citing.

label: USP — oligonucleotide standards programme
status_note: negative result re-confirmed 2026-10-28: USP oligonucleotide standards page lists phosphoramidite Reference Standards and education only; the Peptides & Oligonucleotides Expert Committee work plan names no oligonucleotide general chapter
scope: Phosphoramidite Reference Standards and an oligonucleotide standards programme; chapters <1125>–<1130> cover nucleic-acid analytics, not therapeutic oligo quality.
oligo_note: No dedicated general chapter number verifiable; monitor Pharmacopeial Forum.

label: MHLW/PMDA — Guideline for preclinical safety assessment of oligonucleotide therapeutics
scope: Japanese nonclinical safety guideline specific to oligonucleotides.
oligo_note: One of only two binding-style national oligo-specific nonclinical texts worldwide (with the FDA 2024 draft).

label: OSWG — Oligonucleotide Safety Working Group white papers
scope: Consensus papers: off-target hybridisation (2012), exaggerated pharmacology (2013), safety pharmacology and reprotox (2014), genotoxicity (2016), formulated oligos (2017), ADME (2023).
oligo_note: Non-binding but the de-facto field standard; regulators cite them. Linked: 2023 ADME paper.

label: FDA — Novel Excipient Review Pilot Program
status_note: pilot programme (launched 2021; renamed; check current intake status)
scope: Pathway to review novel excipients (e.g. LNP lipids) ahead of an application.
oligo_note: Relevant for LNP-formulated siRNA/mRNA-adjacent delivery.

label: Regulation (EC) No 1901/2006 — Paediatric Regulation
ref: Regulation (EC) No 1901/2006 (CELEX 32006R1901); amended by Regulation (EC) No 1902/2006
status_note: in force (to be replaced by the 2026 EU pharma package after transition)
scope: Mandatory PIP; rewards (SPC extension) and obligations.
oligo_note: Triggers a PIP for most new oligonucleotide actives.

label: EMA — PIP format & content guidance
status_note: in force since 2014-09-30 (EMA news of that date confirms OJ publication of the revised Commission guideline; EUR-Lex text not opened in this check)
scope: How to compile a Paediatric Investigation Plan.

label: EMA — Stepwise PIP (pilot report & routine use)
status_note: final report (pilot 2023-2025; integration into routine practice planned)
scope: Iterative PIP submission piloted by EMA.
oligo_note: Pilot 2023–2025 reviewed in Feb 2026; EMA plans to integrate stepwise PIPs into routine practice.

label: EU pharmaceutical legislation reform (pharma package)
status_note: adopted by Council 2026-09-28 after provisional agreement 2025-12-11; European Parliament formal adoption / OJ publication pending as of sources dated Sept-Oct 2026; application ~24 months after entry into force (c. 2028)
scope: Reform replacing Directive 2001/83/EC and Reg 726/2004, moving PIPs earlier, formalising iterative PIPs, changing orphan incentives.
oligo_note: Council adopted 28 Sep 2026; Parliament adoption and OJ publication pending. Applies ~24 months after entry into force.

label: Pediatric Research Equity Act (PREA)
status_note: in force (as amended by FDAAA 2007, FDASIA 2012, FDARA 2017)
scope: Mandatory paediatric assessments for certain applications.

label: Best Pharmaceuticals for Children Act (BPCA)
scope: Voluntary paediatric studies with exclusivity incentive.

label: RACE for Children Act (FDARA Title V)
status_note: in force (applies to applications submitted on/after 2020-08-18)
scope: Molecularly targeted oncology drugs must study paediatric cancers when target is relevant.
oligo_note: Directly pulls paediatric-oncology oligos into mandatory study.

label: FDA — Relevant molecular targets list (RACE)
scope: Targets that trigger / waive paediatric oncology studies under FDARA.
oligo_note: Check your oligo's target here at discovery; a listed target means paediatric study obligations.

label: FDA — iPSP (initial Pediatric Study Plan) guidance
scope: Format/content and timing of the iPSP.

label: Regulation (EC) No 141/2000 — Orphan Regulation
status_note: in force (to be replaced by the 2026 EU pharma package)
scope: Orphan designation criteria and 10-year market exclusivity.
oligo_note: Many oligo indications are rare → orphan-eligible.

label: EMA — PRIME (PRIority MEdicines)
status_note: in force (scheme launched March 2016; document last updated 2018-05-07); applicant guidance EMA/7872/2021 updated 2026-06-30
scope: Enhanced early support for high-unmet-need medicines.

label: Conditional marketing authorisation
scope: Approval on less complete data with specific obligations.

label: EMA — Accelerated assessment
scope: Shortened review timetable for major-interest medicines.

label: Orphan Drug Act
scope: Orphan designation; 7-year exclusivity, tax credits.

label: FDA — Breakthrough Therapy designation
status_note: final (May 2014; accelerated-approval content to be replaced by Dec 2024 draft once finalised)
scope: Intensive guidance for substantial-improvement candidates.

label: FDA — Fast Track designation
status_note: final (May 2014; accelerated-approval content to be replaced by Dec 2024 draft once finalised)
scope: Rolling review, more frequent interaction.

label: FDA — Accelerated Approval
scope: Approval on surrogate endpoints with confirmatory obligation.
oligo_note: Dec 2024 draft guidance would replace the accelerated-approval section of the 2014 expedited-programs guidance.

label: FDA — Rare Pediatric Disease Priority Review Voucher
ref: FD&C Act §529 · 21 U.S.C. 360ff · reauthorised by Pub. L. 119-75 (CAA 2026, §§6601–6605)
status_note: in force — designations authorised through 2029-09-30 (programme had lapsed 2024-12-20). Pub. L. 119-75 confirmed on govinfo (3 Feb 2026); the reauthorising sections (CAA 2026 §§6601–6605, Division J) were not reached in this check — dates rest on a law-firm summary
scope: Transferable priority-review voucher for rare paediatric disease approvals.
oligo_note: Lapsed Dec 2024, reauthorised by Pub. L. 119-75 (3 Feb 2026) with designations through 30 Sep 2029. High value for rare paediatric oligo programmes.

label: Regulation (EU) No 536/2014 — Clinical Trials Regulation
status_note: in force (applicable since 2022-01-31; transition from Directive 2001/20/EC ended 2025-01-30)
scope: Single EU trial application via CTIS.

label: 21 CFR Part 312 — Investigational New Drug
scope: US IND requirements to begin clinical investigation.

label: UK — Clinical trial authorisation (SI 2004/1031 as amended by SI 2025/538)
status_note: in force (web guidance, updated for 2026 regime)
scope: UK trials regime; substantially amended regulations in force from 28 Apr 2026.

label: Hybridisation-dependent off-target effects
scope: Sequence-complementary off-target binding.
oligo_note: Bioinformatic + in vitro screening expected; shapes nonclinical design.

label: Immunostimulation (TLR / pro-inflammatory)
scope: Innate-immune activation (CpG/TLR9), complement.
oligo_note: Class effect; informs species selection and monitoring.

label: Hepatotoxicity
scope: Dose-limiting liver findings for several chemistries.

label: Renal accumulation / nephrotoxicity
scope: Proximal-tubule accumulation, especially PS backbones.

label: Thrombocytopenia (platelet class effect)
scope: Platelet declines seen with some 2'-MOE/PS ASOs.

label: Oligonucleotide impurity control
scope: n-1/n+1, shortmers, depurination, process-related impurities.
oligo_note: Small-molecule thresholds (Q3A) fit poorly; needs tailored strategy.

label: Delivery & conjugation
scope: GalNAc, antibody conjugates (AOC), LNP, peptide carriers.
oligo_note: Carrier dictates which additional guidelines (S6, excipient) apply.

label: CNS delivery / intrathecal administration
scope: IT/ICV dosing, neurotoxicity, local tolerance.
oligo_note: Relevant for medulloblastoma/DMG oligos; adds local-tolerance studies.

label: Clinical pharmacology profile
scope: Tissue PK, low CYP involvement, hepatic/renal impairment, QT, immunogenicity.

label: ICH E9 — Statistical principles for clinical trials
scope: Statistical design and analysis.

label: FDA — Nonclinical safety assessment of oligonucleotide-based therapeutics (draft)
status_note: draft (Nov 2024; comment period closed; not finalised as of 2026-10-28 per FDA page)
scope: FDA's first general nonclinical guidance specific to oligonucleotides: species selection, off-target, immunostimulation, class toxicities, study design.
oligo_note: The central US nonclinical reference for any oligo IND; draft since Nov 2024.

label: FDA — IND submissions for individualised ASO products (administrative, draft)
scope: Pre-IND interaction, IND content and timing for n-of-1/n-of-few ASOs for severely debilitating or life-threatening (SDLT) genetic diseases.
oligo_note: Applies to academic/sponsor-investigator bespoke ASO programmes (Milasen-type).

label: MHLW/PMDA — Points to consider for quality of oligonucleotide therapeutics
scope: Quality expectations (manufacturing, characterisation, impurities, specifications, stability) for oligonucleotide therapeutics.
oligo_note: Directly applicable in Japan; useful cross-reference for impurity classification.

label: FDA — FDARA guidance on paediatric studies of molecularly targeted oncology drugs
scope: How FDA implements RACE Act requirements: molecular target relevance, iPSP timing, waivers/deferrals, same-in-class considerations.
oligo_note: Operational rules for RACE Act obligations; decisive for paediatric-oncology oligos.

label: EMA — First-in-human and early clinical trials: risk identification & mitigation
scope: Integrated protocols, dose selection (MABEL/NOAEL), sentinel dosing, stopping rules for FIH/early trials.
oligo_note: Applies to FIH oligonucleotide trials; dose selection should consider tissue accumulation and class effects (complement activation, thrombocytopenia).

label: EMA — Quality documentation for investigational medicinal products (IMPD-Q)
status_note: in force (Rev. 2; Rev. 1 requirements applied from 2018-05-28)
scope: IMPD-Q content for chemical IMPs by phase (S/P sections, specifications, stability, GMP).
oligo_note: Governs IMPD quality for synthetic oligonucleotides in EU CTAs; the EMA draft oligo guideline adds oligo-specific CTA expectations.

label: FDA — Clinical pharmacology considerations for antibody-drug conjugates
scope: Bioanalysis, dosing, exposure-response, intrinsic factors, QTc, immunogenicity and DDI for ADCs with cytotoxic small-molecule payloads (oncology).
oligo_note: Closest FDA analogue for antibody–oligonucleotide conjugates (AOC).

label: EMA — Monoclonal antibodies: development, production, characterisation, specification
status_note: in force (effective 2016-09-01); revision (Rev. 2) at concept-paper stage (EMA/CHMP/BWP/245588/2023)
scope: Quality requirements for mAbs and related products including conjugates.
oligo_note: Applies to the antibody component of AOCs.

label: FDA — Drug products containing nanomaterials
scope: CMC, nonclinical and clinical considerations for products containing nanomaterials (1-100 nm and up to 1 um) in the finished dosage form.
oligo_note: Applies to LNP-formulated siRNA.

label: FDA — Liposome drug products: CMC, PK and labelling
scope: CMC (lipid components, characterisation, stability), PK/BA and labelling for liposomal products.
oligo_note: Reference point for lipid-based oligo formulations.

label: ICH Q14 — Analytical procedure development
scope: Science- and risk-based analytical procedure development, analytical target profile, lifecycle management.
oligo_note: Supports platform analytical approaches for oligonucleotide families (relevant to individualised ASO and multi-sequence programmes).

label: ICH M10 — Bioanalytical method validation
status_note: in force (Step 4 2022-05-24; FDA copy updated Jan 2025)
scope: Validation of chromatographic and ligand-binding bioanalytical assays for PK/TK.
oligo_note: Governs oligo PK assays (hybridisation ELISA, LC-MS); ligand-binding vs chromatographic choice matters.

label: ICH Q3C(R9) — Residual solvents
scope: PDE limits for residual solvents.
oligo_note: Oligo solid-phase synthesis uses large solvent volumes (e.g. acetonitrile); Q3C limits apply directly.

label: ICH E14/S7B Q&As — QT/QTc integrated risk assessment
scope: Integrated nonclinical-clinical QT risk assessment; use of concentration-QTc modelling and nonclinical data to support waiving a TQT study.
oligo_note: Basis for the QT approach in FDA's oligo clin-pharm guidance.

label: ICH Q1 — Stability testing (consolidated, draft)
status_note: draft (Step 2 April 2025; Step 3 consultation closed Sept 2025; Step 4 planned Nov 2026)
scope: Consolidation of Q1A–F into one stability guideline; Q1A(R2) remains in force until adoption.
oligo_note: Will become the governing stability text for oligonucleotide substances/products once at Step 4/5; monitor Nov 2026 ICH meeting outcome.

label: FDA — Rare diseases: considerations for drug development
status_note: final (Dec 2023; finalises 2019 draft 'Rare Diseases: Common Issues in Drug Development')
scope: Natural history, biomarkers/surrogates, nonclinical flexibility, trial design, evidence of effectiveness in rare diseases.
oligo_note: Framework for most oligonucleotide indications; cross-reference with RDEP and plausible-mechanism framework.

label: FDA — Rare Disease Evidence Principles (RDEP)
status_note: in force (agency process, not a guidance document)
scope: Process for therapies addressing a known genetic defect in very small populations (<~1,000 US patients) with rapid deterioration and no alternatives: approval on one adequate and well-controlled study plus robust confirmatory evidence (mechanistic, biomarker, natural history, expanded access data); request before pivotal trial.
oligo_note: Evidence pathway for very small populations; relevant to ultra-rare and n-of-few oligo programmes.

label: Regulation (EC) No 726/2004 — Centralised procedure
ref: Regulation (EC) No 726/2004 (Art. 14(9) accelerated assessment; Art. 14-a conditional MA; Art. 3 mandatory centralised scope)
status_note: in force (to be replaced by the 2026 EU pharma package)
scope: Centralised authorisation; legal basis for accelerated assessment (Art 14(9)) and conditional MA (Art 14-a).
oligo_note: Orphan and biotech-process products are mandatory centralised; synthetic oligonucleotides for orphan indications therefore go centralised.

label: FDA — INDs prepared by sponsor-investigators (draft)
status_note: draft (notice of availability 80 FR, 2015-05-15); still draft
scope: IND preparation for academic sponsor-investigators.
oligo_note: Route for academic investigators running their own oligo IND (incl. n-of-1 ASOs).

label: Goyenvalle et al. — Considerations in the preclinical safety assessment of ASOs (incl. CNS local delivery)
scope: Review with a dedicated section on toxicities associated with CNS local delivery: intrathecal and intracerebroventricular dosing, CSF and brain exposure, rodent neurotoxicity.
oligo_note: Closest thing to a field standard for IT/ICV ASO nonclinical design; non-binding.

label: Toxicologic Pathology Forum — Procedure-related effects of direct CNS delivery of oligonucleotides (rodent, dog, NHP)
scope: Interpretation of functional and histopathologic findings in vehicle-dosed control animals after ICV (mouse) and IT (rat, dog, NHP) oligonucleotide administration.
oligo_note: Separates procedure artefacts from test-article neurotoxicity in IT studies — the question regulators ask first.

label: Korte et al. — Procedure-related spinal cord lesions after lumbar intrathecal bolus of oligonucleotides in cynomolgus monkeys
status_note: published (library record opened; full text not read)
scope: Diagnosing procedure-related spinal cord lesions in NHP IT bolus studies so that the maximum tolerated dose is not misattributed.
oligo_note: NHP IT methodology reference.

label: Toxicologic Pathology Forum — Adverse versus non-adverse nerve fibre degeneration in intrathecal oligonucleotide studies
scope: Opinion on classifying nerve fibre degeneration in nonclinical toxicity studies of oligonucleotides delivered into the intrathecal space.
oligo_note: Lead from a library record; DOI and year still to be confirmed before citing.

label: FDA — Drug-induced liver injury: premarketing clinical evaluation
scope: How to detect, evaluate and report hepatotoxicity signals in clinical development (Hy's law).
oligo_note: The clinical counterpart to the hepatotoxicity class effect; applies to 2'-MOE/cEt programmes in particular.

label: FDA — Pharmacokinetics in patients with impaired renal function
scope: Design and analysis of renal-impairment PK studies and dosing impact.
oligo_note: Relevant because PS oligonucleotides accumulate in proximal tubule and are renally cleared; cross-referenced by the FDA oligo clin-pharm guidance.

label: ICH Q1A(R2) — Stability testing of new drug substances and products
scope: Stability study design; in force until the consolidated Q1 is adopted.

label: ICH E9(R1) — Estimands and sensitivity analysis (addendum)
scope: Estimand framework; addendum to E9.

label: ICH E6(R2) — Good Clinical Practice (superseded)
scope: Previous GCP text; replaced by E6(R3).

label: FDA — Expedited programs for serious conditions (drugs and biologics)
scope: Fast Track, Breakthrough, Accelerated Approval, Priority Review in one guidance.
oligo_note: Accelerated-approval section to be replaced by the Dec 2024 draft once finalised.

label: EMA — Quality documentation for medicinal products used with a medical device
scope: Quality documentation for integral, co-packaged and referenced drug–device combinations; in effect since 2022-01-01.
oligo_note: Applies where an oligonucleotide is given through a named device (implanted reservoir, port, pump) or supplied with one; not to plain lumbar puncture.

label: 21 CFR Part 4 — Regulation of combination products
ref: 21 CFR 4 (Subpart A cGMP; Subpart B postmarketing safety reporting)
scope: cGMP and postmarketing safety reporting for drug–device combination products.
oligo_note: US counterpart for device-delivered oligonucleotides (ICV reservoirs, implanted pumps).
